exposure: short time interval from onset of placental abruption to delivery
cohort: 60 singleton deliveries complicated by placental abruption and a live fetus who were transported by ambulance between January 2006 and December 2018
finding: Severe neonatal asphyxia was a risk factor for DIC in cases of placental abruption, while a short time interval from onset to delivery was a negative risk factor for DIC.
